item.title: Industry Analytics Weekly Stats [12/3 - 12/10]
item.description: Winter racing is in full swing with 1/10th scale electric off-road taking up 30% of the 17,000+ weekly entries. Check out all the information here. #IndustryAnalytics

item.title: New ProTek RC PTK-630 Servo
item.description: ProTek RC is pleased to announce the release of the PTK-630 Digital Brushless Servo. The ProTek RC 630 is designed for racers who demand precision, speed, and durability.

item.title: New Team Xray 1/8th Scale Titanium Shock Stand-Offs
item.description: Team Xray has released new titanium shock stand-offs for the 1/8th Off-road and GT platforms.

item.title: New Hudy Mini Power Block Power Supply
item.description: Xray has released a new power supply option with a smaller footprint than the standard external power supply used in RC.

item.title: New Hudy Carbon Touring Car Rear Wing Mount
item.description: The Hudy carbon rear touring car wing mount which replaces M3 nut for fixation of the rear wing from underneath the bodies prolongs the body shell and rear wing life.

item.title: New Team Xray Lush Wide 1/10th Off-Road Rear Wing
item.description: Team Xray has released their Lush 1/10th scale 2wd and 4wd buggy wing in a wider option for dirt and carpet applications.

item.title: New Moto Obscura Losi XX Carbon Fiber Front Brace
item.description: Now available from Moto Obscura is a new adjustable carbon fiber front brace for all Team Losi XX and XXT series models.

item.title: New Team Associated 1/10th Off-Road Series -4 Offset Aluminum Rear Hubs
item.description: Factory Team introduces the new FT aluminum rear hubs, -4 offset for the 1/10th scale off-road Team Associated platforms.

item.title: New Matrix 1/10th Buggy Slicks
item.description: Matrix has released their first 1/10th scale off-road offering with a slick option for 1/10th scale buggies.

item.title: Schimmel Announces Team Xray Departure
item.description: Brennan Schimmel has announced via social media today that he will be leaving Team Xray after one year, a year that included his first modified national title.
